reason: Not a distinct defect: its one checkable observation — 'In Tasks as' in the margin and 'Tasks has it' in the receipt reporting one fact at once — is exactly what seam-landing-reported-four-ways already names, with better evidence and the same single guard, so confirming it would fix one thing twice. Its added counts do not survive measurement: of the four labels, 'Already in Tasks' is the section head over four ledger rows and 'Sent to Tasks.' is the undo strip's own label naming what would be reverted; of the four reassurances, .peelBoundary is the pre-commit contract and is gone the instant the receipt replaces the peel (measured at 1440: only .peelWhy and the ledger .cnt are on screen after send), and the aria-live line is the receipt's accessibility channel, not a fifth voice. Three of its four edits would make the work worse — shortening the live region drops 'In The house.', the destination, from the only channel an AT user gets it in at that moment; cutting the ledger head to a bare '4 so far' trades a standing sentence for a naked count on the surface whose recorded decision is that counts are not its loudest object; and putting the wording on the undo pill would add a FIFTH printing of the sentence the finding is complaining about.
